votes.section: PUBLIC HEARING/RIGHT OF WAY EASEMENT VACATION/ORDINANCE
votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larsen to approve Ordinance No. 2023-015 vacating an existing right of way easement for utilities located St. George City Council Regular Meeting Minutes between 600 South Street and 700 South Street and also 800 East Street and southbound I-15.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larkin to approve Ordinance No. 2023-011 approving a development agreement on approximately 1.0 acres located at 3681 South Mulberry Drive for the purpose of allowing the applicant to build a garage in Open Space zone in exchange for a sewer easement and drainage easement. St. George City Council Regular Meeting Minutes
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larsen to approve Ordinance No. 2023-016 changing the zone from C-2 (Commercial) to PD-C (Planned Development Commercial) on approximately 2.83 acres located at 3270 East Flowers Way to build Fire Station #10 on the property.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember McArthur to adjourn.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)
